interpretation.architecture_progress: A new source-trained four-way state-dependent partition learner preserved and represented multiple causal action operators without binary aliasing; inferred highbit and parity from real observed source transitions rather than phase labels, with exact source/cold custody. The same set of possible four partitions was precommitted, not invented from scratch.
interpretation.null_decisive: On both frozen DEV seeds the new contextual model was almost exactly equivalent to exact structural BMA; at scored points the results were BIT-EXACT EQUAL. Its state-partition hard gate added no measurable benefit over the strong Bayesian comparator. It beat the fully fitted tabular model only by ~0.000802 and 0.000613 pooled Brier, far below ≥0.010 preregistered threshold. The NO-GO is due to lack of required strong-conventional-control gain, NOT the separately unrelated infrastructure workflow.
interpretation.causal_baseline_falsified: The false context-invariant XOR model was worse by ~0.0734 and ~0.0779, showing state-dependent physical rules were relevant and learned by every properly contextual model. That does not establish a superior new representation relative to tabular or exact Bayes.
interpretation.limitations: World 0 true class highbit and World 1 parity are included among the four source-trained candidate priors, and the reward laws are simple stochastic binary functions. Exact Bayesian class posterior has the correct model in its hypothesis set; performance equivalence is expected once source identifies the class. Does not test arbitrary unknown physical mechanics or novel semantic grounding.
interpretation.efficiency: Full checkpoint payloads include complete source receipts (~70KB/model), not a lean weight-only native footprint. Additional model/evidence work means compute cannot be claimed matched. CI process times are feasibility measurements, not throughput speedups.
interpretation.scientific_policy: Do not tune or re-run original consumed DEV 48111/48112 as independent confirmation. Leave registered pilots and primaries untouched; maintain native Yggdrasil accepted binary source, original owners, FORGE and other research tracks isolated.

next_executable: Stop CKAD48 under frozen scientific NO_GO. Rather than another state partition mask selector, evaluate a true latent causal relation learner that discovers a new state-feature partition and effect grammar from source (including unknown nonlinear action state dependence) on novel disjoint rule-family worlds, against strong fully trained tabular, exact matched symbolic and BMA controls. Must preregister seeds, cost, negative controls and owner first-use separately.
